name: Saitama (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Saitama city emblem: a deep-green figure suggesting a striding person with a dot for the head, flanked by two light-green leaf shapes, together evoking a sprouting young plant.
history: Saitama City was created on 1 May 2001 by the merger of Urawa, Ōmiya and Yono; the emblem and flag date from the merger.

features.role: Saitama city emblem — a sprouting figure with two leaves
features.symbolism: symbolises the young city growing dynamically; adopted when Urawa, Ōmiya and Yono merged to form Saitama City
